title: ATTACK_TARGET with a ready pulse laser far from the target dispatches to ATTACK_FLY_TO_TARGET, clears the jink and resets frustration
derivation: A Mamba-like ship (forward pulse laser, range 12500, equipment.plist weapon_info) at accuracy 2 and frustration 2.0, a stationary ship at range 8000 (centres 8080 apart), jink (50, -60, 70). Weapon temperature is fixed at 0 under the scope cut, so the forward weapon is ready (4079: no in-good-range requirement for the forward weapon) and the unarmed branch is skipped; the heating branch is dead. nearby is range < 0.035 * 12500 = 437.5: false at 8000. Falling to `else if (forward_weapon_ready)` (4156): jink = zero (4157); beam range 12500 is not above 12500 (4160); accuracy 2 is not below COMBAT_AI_ISNT_AWFUL, so the default `behaviour = BEHAVIOUR_ATTACK_FLY_TO_TARGET` (4168-4169); frustration = 0 at the end (4184). desired_speed is untouched (100). Closed form.

checks.note: 4168-4169: armed, accuracy at least 0, not nearby, not sniper range
the dispatcher does not touch desired_speed

title: ATTACK_TARGET with no forward weapon (the Shuttle, weapon range 0) dispatches to ATTACK_FLY_FROM_TARGET and leaves the jink alone
derivation: A Shuttle-like ship (forward_weapon_type WEAPON_NONE) at accuracy 2 against a stationary ship at range 3000, jink (150, -150, 900). isWeaponNone(forward) leaves the weapon type nil (ShipEntity.m:443-466), so weaponRange = getWeaponRangeFromType(nil) = [nil weaponRange] = 0 (13041-13044): the Shuttle's weapon range is 0, not a laser range. No weapon is ready and all four mounts are none, so the unarmed branch sets ATTACK_FLY_FROM_TARGET (4098-4099) without touching the jink (the branch never zeroes it), then frustration resets (4184).

title: ATTACK_TARGET at accuracy -2 with approach aspect -1 dispatches to ATTACK_FLY_TO_TARGET_SIX
derivation: A Mamba-like ship (pulse laser, range 12500) at accuracy -2 against a stationary ship at range 8000. Not nearby (437.5), not sniper range (the pulse range 12500 is not above 12500), forward weapon ready, jink zeroed (4157). The target's forward is (0, 0, 1), so the approach aspect dot(normalise(self - target), forward) = dot((0, 0, -1), forward) is -1: the target's nose points away from the ship. Accuracy below COMBAT_AI_ISNT_AWFUL with aspect below 0 selects SIX (4164-4165: "SIX also needs aspect below 0", the review cited 4158); with aspect at least 0 it selects TWELVE (4166-4167). Frustration resets (4184).

title: ATTACK_TARGET nearby at accuracy 2 draws two ranrot values for the evasive jink and dispatches to ATTACK_FLY_FROM_TARGET
derivation: A Mamba-like ship (pulse laser, range 12500, max_flight_pitch 1.4) flying forward at 100 m/s against a stationary-position ship at range 300 flying toward it at 60 m/s: nearby is range < 0.035 * 12500 = 437.5 (4128) and true; no aft, port or starboard weapon exists (4131-4136 are dead), so the plain `else if (nearby)` branch runs (4137). pitching_over is false, so the jink is redrawn (4138): relativeSpeed = |self.velocity - target.velocity| with velocity = forward * flightSpeed (11159-11166; no Newtonian velocity) = |(0, 0, 100) - (0, 0, -60)| = 160, and setEvasiveJink(range + COMBAT_JINK_OFFSET - relativeSpeed / max_flight_pitch) = 300 + 500 - 160 / 1.4 = 685.714 (4147-4148). At accuracy 2 setEvasiveJink consumes exactly two ranrot draws (the scripted [0.7, 0.3]): jink.x = floor(0.7 * 256) - 128 = 51, +128 = 179; jink.y = floor(0.3 * 256) - 128 = -52, -128 = -180 (8985-8999). Accuracy 2 is below COMBAT_AI_FLEES_BETTER (6), so the behaviour is ATTACK_FLY_FROM_TARGET (4153-4154). Draws consumed: 2.

title: perform ATTACK_TARGET leaves EVASIVE_ACTION alone: no draw, no desiredRange change, no frustration reset
derivation: A Mamba-like ship already in EVASIVE_ACTION with frustration 0.25 and desired range 1000, a stationary ship at range 4920 facing the ship. performAttack tests `behaviour != BEHAVIOUR_EVASIVE_ACTION` (ShipEntityAI.m:351) and does nothing: no draw (the scripted list is empty), desired_range stays 1000, frustration stays 0.25 (an exactly representable value). title: ATTACK_FLY_FROM_TARGET with weapon range 0 and zero jink returns to ATTACK_TARGET at once because range > 0
derivation: An unarmed Shuttle-like ship (max speed 80, max_flight_pitch 0.9, weapon range 0, see the dispatcher row) in ATTACK_FLY_FROM_TARGET with initial success_factor 1000, desired_speed 0, accuracy 2, against a stationary ship at range 1000. Tick 1: range 1000, success_factor = 1000 (4736-4737); last_success_factor 1000 is not above it, so the target is not closing and frustration += dt / 4 (4743-4748); frustration stays far below 10 (no draw). desired_speed 0 is below 0.5 * 80, so it becomes maxFlightSpeed 80 (4771-4773). The exit test (4775) is range > 0.5 * weaponRange + 15 * jink.x = 0 + 15 * jink.x, or flightSpeed 0 > (25600 - 1000) * 0.9 / 6.28 = 3525 (false). With jink.x 0 the threshold is 0, and range 1000 > 0, so the ship zeroes its jink, sets ATTACK_TARGET and frustration 0 (4776-4778).
